stories.headline: Nvidia enlists six Wall Street firms to mobilize over $500B for AI compute financing

key_facts.fact: Nvidia announced on August 10, 2026 strategic partnerships to establish independent compute financing platforms with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR, aiming to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital for AI infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA today announced strategic partnerships to establish independent compute financing platforms with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital for the buildout of AI infrastructure over time.

key_facts.fact: The deals are memorandums of understanding, not final contracts: Nvidia says the partnerships 'remain subject to execution of the final agreements.'
key_facts.excerpt: Memorandums of understanding signed with six of the world's premier financial institutions... These partnerships remain subject to execution of the final agreements.

key_facts.fact: The structure lets Nvidia customers — hyperscalers, frontier AI labs and enterprises — finance GPUs and data centers with institutional credit and private capital instead of their own balance sheets.
key_facts.excerpt: By using institutional credit, insurance funds and private capital to underwrite GPUs and data centers, Nvidia is helping its end users secure financing without tapping their own balance sheets.

key_facts.fact: BlackRock CEO Larry Fink called the project the start of the 'next future for financial engineering,' comparing it to the creation of mortgage-backed securities in the 1970s.
key_facts.excerpt: BlackRock's Fink said that he believed this project was the start of the 'next future for financial engineering,' akin to the creation of mortgage-backed securities in the 1970s.

key_facts.fact: Blackstone President Jon Gray said AI compute will be seen as a 'financeable asset class' like homes are to mortgage lenders, and that AI use at Blackstone portfolio companies has surged sevenfold this year.
key_facts.excerpt: AI compute will be seen as a 'financeable asset class' in the same way that mortgage lenders look at homes, Gray of Blackstone said on CNBC. Demand for AI is outstripping supply, with use at Blackstone portfolio companies surging sevenfold this year.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia did not disclose financial terms, individual firm commitments or a timetable for deploying the planned $500 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: The company did not disclose the financial terms, investment commitments by individual firms or a timetable for deploying the planned $500 billion.

stories.headline: Intel upsizes share sale to $20B and prices at $95 after $100B+ in demand

key_facts.fact: Intel priced 210,526,315 shares at $95 each, upsizing the offering to $20 billion from the $15 billion announced the previous day.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel priced the underwritten public offering of 210,526,315 shares of common stock at a public offering price of $95 per share... The offering was upsized to $20 billion from the previously announced offering size of $15 billion.

key_facts.fact: The share sale drew more than $100 billion in demand, according to people familiar with the matter, and the $95 price is a 6.5% discount to Friday's close.
key_facts.excerpt: The chipmaker priced the offering at $95 per share... That represents a discount of 6.5% to Friday's closing price... The share sale drew more than $100 billion in demand, people familiar with the matter said.

key_facts.fact: Net proceeds are expected to be about $19.7 billion, for general corporate purposes including capital expenditures and working capital; the offering is set to close August 12, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: The net proceeds from the offering will be approximately $19.7 billion... Intel intends to use the net proceeds from the offering for general corporate purposes, which may include, but are not limited to, capital expenditures and working capital. The offering is expected to close on August 12, 2026.

key_facts.fact: Underwriters received a 30-day option to buy up to 31,578,947 additional shares at the offering price.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel has granted to the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to 31,578,947 additional shares of common stock at the public offering price, less underwriting discounts.

key_facts.fact: Intel shares fell more than 4% on Monday when the initial $15 billion deal was disclosed, then gained about 1% in premarket trading after the upsized pricing.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel's shares dropped more than 4% on Monday after the company revealed the initial offering... Intel shares gained about 1% in premarket trading Tuesday.

stories.headline: TSMC and Sony sign binding deal for $4.69B image-sensor venture in Kumamoto

key_facts.fact: On August 11, 2026, Sony Semiconductor Solutions and TSMC announced a legally binding definitive agreement to establish Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation, a joint venture in Koshi City, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan.
key_facts.excerpt: Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited today announced the execution of a legally binding definitive agreement for the establishment of Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation as a joint venture in Koshi City, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan.

key_facts.fact: Sony will contribute roughly 465 billion yen (about $2.92 billion) in cash and assets — including its newly built Kumamoto fab, transferred via a company split — while TSMC contributes about 282 billion yen in cash, for a combined $4.69 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Sony will be the controlling shareholder and invest 465 billion yen ($2.92 billion) through a combination of cash and asset transfers, including its newly constructed chip factory in Kumamoto prefecture, while TSMC will invest 282 billion yen.

key_facts.fact: The JV will make image sensors for smartphones using advanced process technology, with volume production expected to begin in 2029.
key_facts.excerpt: The JV will serve as a core hub for the development and manufacturing activities required for the volume production of image sensors for smartphones utilizing advanced manufacturing process technology. The JV is expected to commence volume production in 2029.

key_facts.fact: Sony will be the sole controlling shareholder and consolidate the JV as a subsidiary, appointing its Representative Director; capital contributions will be phased based on market demand.
key_facts.excerpt: Sony will be the sole controlling shareholder and the JV is planned to operate as a consolidated subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation. The Representative Director of the JV is planned to be appointed by Sony.

key_facts.fact: Additional investment needed to reach the JV's planned production capacity is being considered on the premise of Japanese government support, and the deal still needs regulatory approvals.
key_facts.excerpt: investments required to realize the production capacity planned by the JV are being considered on the premise that they would receive support from the Japanese government... The establishment of the JV and completion of the transaction are subject to the receipt of required regulatory approvals.

key_facts.fact: The definitive agreement follows a non-binding memorandum of understanding the two companies signed on May 8, 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Based on the memorandum of understanding announced on May 8, 2026, Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited have proceeded with discussions regarding a strategic partnership.

stories.headline: Bitcoin miner Riot leases 191 MW in Texas to a frontier AI lab in a $9.1B, 20-year deal

key_facts.fact: Riot Platforms disclosed in an August 10, 2026 SEC filing a 20-year lease for 191 megawatts of data-center capacity at its Rockdale, Texas campus, describing the tenant only as a 'leading frontier AI lab'; Bloomberg identified the customer as Anthropic.
key_facts.excerpt: Riot called the customer a 'leading frontier AI lab' in its 10 August filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, while Bloomberg later identified the unnamed tenant as Anthropic through people familiar with the agreement.

key_facts.fact: The base lease runs through June 2048 and is expected to generate $9.1 billion in revenue; two five-year extension options could raise the total to about $16.1 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Riot's Rockdale, Texas, campus will supply 191 megawatts of IT capacity under the terms of the 20-year lease, which extends through June 2048... Two five-year extension options could raise the total contract value to $16.1 billion.

key_facts.fact: Capacity will be delivered in stages: 96 megawatts by December 2027 and the full 191 megawatts by June 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: Riot plans to bring capacity online in stages, reaching 96 megawatts by December 2027 and completing the full 191-megawatt buildout by June 2028.

key_facts.fact: Riot arranged a $573 million interim financing facility through Morgan Stanley for early construction while it works on a permanent investment-grade credit backstop.
key_facts.excerpt: Morgan Stanley is providing $573 million of interim financing for initial development while an investment-grade credit backstop is completed.

key_facts.fact: With an earlier AMD lease of 50 MW at the same site, Riot's contracted data-center capacity reaches 241 megawatts and roughly $9.8 billion in long-term contracted revenue, all signed within six months.
key_facts.excerpt: Riot CEO Jason Les said in a statement that the two agreements together bring the company's total signed capacity to 241 megawatts and roughly $9.8 billion in long-term contracted revenue, all accumulated within six months. The earlier deal was with Advanced Micro Devices.

key_facts.fact: Riot shares jumped about 25% to $24.40 in late trading after the disclosure, having fallen 5.5% in the regular session.
key_facts.excerpt: Investors nevertheless sent Riot shares up about 25% to $24.40 in late trading after they had fallen 5.5% during the regular session.

stories.headline: Unitree's Shanghai IPO is 8,288 times oversubscribed as retail piles into humanoid robots

key_facts.fact: Unitree Robotics said on August 10, 2026 — the day online subscriptions opened — that the retail tranche of its STAR Market IPO was oversubscribed about 8,288.82 times, triggering a clawback mechanism.
key_facts.excerpt: Chinese robot maker Unitree said on Monday its Shanghai initial public offering was oversubscribed by about 8,288.82 times by retail investors, triggering a clawback mechanism.

key_facts.fact: More than 9.78 million retail accounts bid for 53.64 billion shares, leaving a final online winning rate of roughly 0.018% — about one in 5,525 applicants.
key_facts.excerpt: the final online winning rate of Unitree Robotics' IPO... is razor-thin 0.0181 percent... Before the clawback, more than 9.78 million accounts had submitted valid applications for a staggering 53.64 billion shares.

key_facts.fact: The company priced 40.45 million shares at 150.8 yuan ($22.35) each, raising 6.10 billion yuan (about $904 million) and valuing Unitree at roughly 61 billion yuan ($9 billion); payment is due August 12.
key_facts.excerpt: The company set the offer price at 150.8 yuan ($22.35) per share, valuing the company at roughly 61 billion yuan on issuance. A total of 40.45 million shares are being offered... with payment due by August 12.

key_facts.fact: Unitree will be China's first onshore-listed humanoid robot maker; the price implies 219 times 2025 earnings and about 36 times sales.
key_facts.excerpt: Unitree, set to become China's first onshore-listed humanoid robot maker, priced its IPO last week at 150.80 yuan ($22.36), valuing the company at more than 60 billion yuan.

key_facts.fact: A Smart Analytics Global report released the same day put Unitree's humanoid shipments at about 5,900 units in the first half of 2026, up 170% year-on-year and 31% of the world total, second to AGIBOT.
key_facts.excerpt: Unitree's humanoid robot shipment accounted for 31 percent in the world in the first half of 2026, with shipments rising 170 percent year-on-year to approximately 5,900 units, ranking second after another Chinese robot vendor AGIBOT.

key_facts.fact: The clawback moved 3.2 million shares from the institutional tranche to retail, lifting the final online allocation to 9.7 million shares; the institutional tranche itself was 2,760.67 times oversubscribed.
key_facts.excerpt: This clawback reallocated 3.2 million shares from the offline institutional offering to the online retail offering, expanding the final online retail issuance volume to 9.7 million shares... This represented an oversubscription multiple of 2,760.67 times the initial offline offering size.

stories.headline: IBM signs $240M deal to build Together AI an Nvidia B300 inference cluster on IBM Cloud

key_facts.fact: IBM announced on August 11, 2026 a multi-year $240 million agreement with Together AI to deploy a large cluster of Nvidia HGX B300 systems on IBM Cloud, with availability expected in Q1 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Under a multi-year $240M agreement between IBM and Together AI, IBM is positioned to deploy a large cluster of NVIDIA HGX B300 systems on IBM Cloud with expected availability in Q1 2027.

key_facts.fact: It is the first dedicated, large-scale cluster built for inference on IBM Cloud, using HGX B300 systems with Nvidia Spectrum-X Ethernet networking; Nvidia says the combination delivers 30x more AI factory output than prior generations.
key_facts.excerpt: This deployment is the first dedicated, large-scale cluster built for inference on IBM Cloud using HGX B300 systems and NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet networking. According to NVIDIA, it is built to deliver 30x more AI factory output compared to prior generations.

key_facts.fact: Together AI will use the cluster to serve open-source model inference to enterprise customers; its platform now processes about 400 trillion tokens a month.
key_facts.excerpt: The neocloud plans to use IBM's Cloud capacity to support its open-source AI model inference business for enterprise customers. Together AI says its platform now processes about 400 trillion tokens a month.

key_facts.fact: The deal pushes IBM into the neocloud market by making Together AI a major cloud tenant rather than a competitor, extending an IBM-Nvidia partnership announced in March to bring Blackwell Ultra GPUs to IBM Cloud.
key_facts.excerpt: The agreement gives IBM a foothold in that market by making Together AI a major cloud tenant rather than a direct competitor... The companies announced plans in March to bring Nvidia Blackwell Ultra GPUs to IBM Cloud.

key_facts.fact: Together AI said it chose IBM and Nvidia for their product roadmaps and the speed of GPU capacity delivery at the lowest possible token cost.
key_facts.excerpt: Together AI chose IBM and Nvidia for their product roadmaps and the speed at which GPU capacity can be delivered at the lowest possible token cost.
